about: Queries labeled with the executor that should answer them. The label is the kind of answer
wanted: characters to read back (visual_text_extraction) or a moment (temporal_grounding).
The hard cases are moments described by text that happens to be on screen - the three
marked from_benchmark were misrouted on the constructed benchmark and cost 57-149 s each.
Rows marked held_out were written after the prompt was last changed and are not echoed in it; in_prompt rows appear there nearly verbatim, so they flatter it.
